answer: The bridge schedule is applied in saffron and tundra publishes each instalment. An farming party as a result cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split so that 36% arrives at settlement and the rest over 12 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 3326 identities would post 4725 proofs and burn roughly 81 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
